    // The sample at column i, row j, with both indices clamped into the array.
    SampleAt(s: HeightField, i: Integer, j: Integer): Number {
        var columns = s.Heights.ColumnCount;
        var rows = s.Heights.RowCount;
        return s.Heights.Row(j.Max(0).Min(rows - 1))[i.Max(0).Min(columns - 1)];
    }

    //==
    // Topological surfaces

    // One lap of the centerline circle in U, across the strip in V. The strip's
    // half-width direction rotates by HalfTwistCount half-turns over the lap, so
    // an odd count returns the strip to its start flipped: the one-sided surface.
    Eval(s: MobiusStrip, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D
    {
        var lap = uv.U.Turns;
        var twist = (uv.U * s.HalfTwistCount.ToNumber * 0.5).Turns;
        var w = (uv.V - 0.5) * s.Width;
        var ring = s.Radius + w * twist.Cos;
        return s.Frame.PointInFrame(Point3D(ring * lap.Cos, ring * lap.Sin, w * twist.Sin));
    }
    // The lap closes in U (flipped when HalfTwistCount is odd); the strip has two
    // free boundary edges in V.
    ClosedU(s: MobiusStrip): Boolean => true;
    ClosedV(s: MobiusStrip): Boolean => false;

    //==
    // # Derived functions for the surface, solid, and volume interfaces
    //
    // Bodies for the interfaces declared in `surfaces-solids.concepts.plato`. Every
    // function's first parameter is interface-typed, so each helper becomes available
    // on every implementing type. Corner and centre samples, the closure
    // classification, and the coefficients of the first fundamental form are all
    // derivable from the interface members alone.
    //
    // A UV surface's canonical domain is the unit square and a volume's the unit
    // cube; evaluation goes through the `Eval` member inherited from `IProcedural`.

    //==
    // # IParametricSurface
    //
    // A surface over the unit-square UV domain (IProcedural<UvCoordinate,
    // Point3D>), with ClosedU / ClosedV seam reports. Corner and centre samples
    // and the closure classification are derivable.

    // The position for a UV coordinate; an intent-revealing alias for Eval.
    PointAt(self: IParametricSurface, uv: UvCoordinate): Point3D
        => self.Eval(uv);

    // The surface position at the (u, v) corner (0, 0).
    CornerPoint00(self: IParametricSurface): Point3D
        => self.Eval((0.0, 0.0));

    // The surface position at the (u, v) corner (1, 0).
    CornerPoint10(self: IParametricSurface): Point3D
        => self.Eval((1.0, 0.0));

    // The surface position at the (u, v) corner (0, 1).
    CornerPoint01(self: IParametricSurface): Point3D
        => self.Eval((0.0, 1.0));

    // The surface position at the (u, v) corner (1, 1).
    CornerPoint11(self: IParametricSurface): Point3D
        => self.Eval((1.0, 1.0));

    // The surface position at the centre of the UV domain, (0.5, 0.5).
    CenterPoint(self: IParametricSurface): Point3D
        => self.Eval((0.5, 0.5));

    // True when the surface seams shut in both parameter directions (a torus).
    IsFullyClosed(self: IParametricSurface): Boolean
        => self.ClosedU && self.ClosedV;

    // True when the surface has a free boundary in both directions (an open
    // patch).
    IsOpenPatch(self: IParametricSurface): Boolean
        => self.ClosedU.Not && self.ClosedV.Not;

    // True when the surface closes in exactly one direction (a tube or cylinder).
    IsTube(self: IParametricSurface): Boolean
        => self.ClosedU != self.ClosedV;

    //==
    // # IDifferentiableSurface
    //
    // A parametric surface with partial derivatives: TangentUAt and TangentVAt
    // span the tangent plane; NormalAt is their oriented unit normal. The
    // coefficients of the first fundamental form follow from the tangents
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/First_fundamental_form).

    // The unit surface normal at the centre of the UV domain.
    NormalAtCenter(self: IDifferentiableSurface): Direction3D
        => self.NormalAt((0.5, 0.5));

    // The U-direction tangent at the centre of the UV domain.
    TangentUAtCenter(self: IDifferentiableSurface): Vector3D
        => self.TangentUAt((0.5, 0.5));

    // The V-direction tangent at the centre of the UV domain.
    TangentVAtCenter(self: IDifferentiableSurface): Vector3D
        => self.TangentVAt((0.5, 0.5));

    // The coefficient E = Tu . Tu of the first fundamental form at uv (the squared
    // stretch along U).
    FirstFundamentalE(self: IDifferentiableSurface, uv: UvCoordinate): Number
        => self.TangentUAt(uv).MagnitudeSquared;

    // The coefficient F = Tu . Tv of the first fundamental form at uv (the
    // U/V shear; zero where the parameter lines meet at right angles).
    FirstFundamentalF(self: IDifferentiableSurface, uv: UvCoordinate): Number
        => self.TangentUAt(uv).Dot(self.TangentVAt(uv));

    // The coefficient G = Tv . Tv of the first fundamental form at uv (the squared
    // stretch along V).
    FirstFundamentalG(self: IDifferentiableSurface, uv: UvCoordinate): Number
        => self.TangentVAt(uv).MagnitudeSquared;

    // True when the parameter lines meet orthogonally at uv, within the given
    // non-negative tolerance on the shear coefficient F.
    IsOrthogonalAt(self: IDifferentiableSurface, uv: UvCoordinate, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => self.FirstFundamentalF(uv).Abs <= tolerance;

    //==
    // # IHeightFieldSurface
    //
    // A surface expressed as an elevation over a ground-plane position
    // (IProcedural<Point2D, Number>): the domain is a world-plane point, the
    // result the height above it.

    // The height above the given ground position; an intent-revealing alias for
    // Eval.
    HeightAt(self: IHeightFieldSurface, position: Point2D): Number
        => self.Eval(position);

    // The height above the origin of the ground plane, (0, 0).
    HeightAtOrigin(self: IHeightFieldSurface): Number
        => self.Eval((0.0, 0.0));

    // The signed elevation change between two ground positions.
    HeightDifference(self: IHeightFieldSurface, from: Point2D, to: Point2D): Number
        => self.Eval(to) - self.Eval(from);

    //==
    // # IParametricVolume
    //
    // A volume over the unit-cube UVW domain (IProcedural<UvwCoordinate,
    // Point3D>): trivariate patches and free-form deformation cages.

    // The position for a UVW coordinate; an intent-revealing alias for Eval.
    PointAt(self: IParametricVolume, uvw: UvwCoordinate): Point3D
        => self.Eval(uvw);

    // The position at the origin corner of the UVW cube, (0, 0, 0).
    CornerPoint(self: IParametricVolume): Point3D
        => self.Eval((0.0, 0.0, 0.0));

    // The position at the far corner of the UVW cube, (1, 1, 1).
    OppositeCornerPoint(self: IParametricVolume): Point3D
        => self.Eval((1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
